content: Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » Homepage Hero Divider Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000098293 Homepage Hero Divider This article goes over the available settings to edit the Hero Divider section on the homepage of the website. To edit this section navigate to: Settings Design Settings Select Content to Display Homepage Hero Divider This section is meant to be displayed on the homepage exclusively. Visual Guide of the Homepage Hero Divider Settings 1. Icon Or Image This setting controls if this section will display an image or if an icon is going to be used instead. Icon This will set the icon for the logo Image This will set the image that will be used instead of the logo icon and slogan. 2. Hide On Mobile? This setting controls if this section will be displayed on mobile devices or not. No This will show the section on mobile devices. Yes This will hide the section on mobile devices 3. Icon Image 1 This setting controls the first icon on the section, click the image of the icon to view the available options. 4. 1 - Title This setting controls the first title on the section. 5. 1 - Caption This setting controls the first Caption on the section. The variable used in this section is custom_117 6. 1 - Link Text This setting controls the first Link Text on the section. If the link needs to open in a new tab, make sure to select the option "Open New Tab " 7. 1 - Link URL This setting controls the first Link Text on the section. If the link needs to open in a new tab, make sure to select the option "Open New Tab " 8. 1 - Link URL This setting controls the first Link Text on the section. If the link needs to open in a new tab, make sure to select the option "Open New Tab " For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
